title: A compilation plays its cases in source order
text: A compilation plays its cases in source order: by the number the user gave each downloaded file; with no number, by the YouTube posting date. A story told across several videos stays in its own order.

source.heading: Confirmed by the user (2026-11-24, answers to the overnight study's questions)

confirm: In what order do the cases play, and does it match the file numbers or posting dates?
